issue_context.title: `brew install` downloads build dependencies if `$HOMEBREW_INSTALL_FROM_API` is set
issue_context.body:
### `brew config` output

```shell
HOMEBREW_VERSION: 3.4.3-43-g6e1b6a3
ORIGIN: https://github.com/Homebrew/brew
HEAD: 6e1b6a3be7ce4f7a6349662ee7092fbf8f19d79c
Last commit: 5 hours ago
Core tap: N/A
HOMEBREW_PREFIX: /usr/local
HOMEBREW_CASK_OPTS: []
HOMEBREW_CORE_GIT_REMOTE: https://github.com/Homebrew/homebrew-core
HOMEBREW_EDITOR: nvim
HOMEBREW_INSTALL_FROM_API: set
HOMEBREW_MAKE_JOBS: 8
Homebrew Ruby: 2.6.8 => /System/Library/Frameworks/Ruby.framework/Versions/2.6/usr/bin/ruby
CPU: octa-core 64-bit kabylake
Clang: 13.1.6 build 1316
Git: 2.35.1 => /usr/local/bin/git
Curl: 7.79.1 => /usr/bin/curl
macOS: 12.3-x86_64
CLT: 13.3.0.0.1.1645755326
Xcode: N/A
```


### `brew doctor` output

At first I thought `brew doctor` hanged, then I supplied `--debug` and wow, it's downloading the world. Honestly this is another bug to be fixed. Not sure how to skip `check_deleted_formula` so I can get the rest of check results.

```shell
$ brew doctor --debug
==> Checking check_access_directories
==> Checking check_brew_git_origin
/usr/local/Homebrew/Library/Homebrew/shims/shared/git --version
==> Checking check_broken_sdks
==> Checking check_casktap_integrity
==> Checking check_clt_minimum_version
==> Checking check_clt_up_to_date
==> Checking check_coretap_integrity
==> Checking check_deleted_formula
/usr/local/Homebrew/Library/Homebrew/shims/shared/curl --disable --cookie /dev/null --globoff --show-error --user-agent Homebrew/3.4.3-43-g6e1b6a3\ \(Macintosh\;\ Intel\ Mac\ OS\ X\ 12.3\)\ curl/7.79.1 --header Accept-Language:\ en --max-time 5 --retry 3 --fail https://formulae.brew.sh/api/bottle/libtermkey.json
/usr/local/Homebrew/Library/Homebrew/shims/shared/curl --disable --cookie /dev/null --globoff --show-error --user-agent Homebrew/3.4.3-43-g6e1b6a3\ \(Macintosh\;\ Intel\ Mac\ OS\ X\ 12.3\)\ curl/7.79.1 --header Accept-Language:\ en --max-time 5 --retry 3 --fail https://formulae.brew.sh/api/bottle/rubberband.json
/usr/local/Homebrew/Library/Homebrew/shims/shared/curl --disable --cookie /dev/null --globoff --show-error --user-agent Homebrew/3.4.3-43-g6e1b6a3\ \(Macintosh\;\ Intel\ Mac\ OS\ X\ 12.3\)\ curl/7.79.1 --header Accept-Language:\ en --max-time 5 --retry 3 --fail https://formulae.brew.sh/api/bottle/cjson.json
...Skipping the rest...
```


### Verification

- [X] I ran `brew update` and am still able to reproduce my issue.
- [ ] I have resolved all warnings from `brew doctor` and that did not fix my problem.

### What were you trying to do (and why)?

This is less a showstopper than https://github.com//Homebrew/brew/issues/13039 but still pretty annoying.

Trying to install a formulae with `$HOMEBREW_INSTALL_FROM_API` set will bring build-only dependencies as well. Luckily only downloaded, not poured.

It looks to me this is just https://github.com//Homebrew/brew/issues/12357 manifested in another form, i.e. brew can't figure out the info needed without a local tap (most of the time).

### What happened (include all command output)?

```
$ brew install leaf-proxy 
==> Downloading https://ghcr.io/v2/homebrew/core/leaf-proxy/blobs/sha256:0954b0fd5638a747ba1512df
Already downloaded: /Users/kid/Library/Caches/Homebrew/downloads/e10182342d6b9193b4fd19216cdd0e3cce2d23d9b241ca300fc114b57356d585--leaf-proxy--0.4.2.monterey.bottle.tar.gz
==> Downloading https://ghcr.io/v2/homebrew/core/rust/blobs/sha256:b377dbe44d8eed401316cba6a645e8
Already downloaded: /Users/kid/Library/Caches/Homebrew/downloads/287f203010ba81561e918b0a30aecf538c6965edb3a777aeceaf50378b4b78c7--rust--1.59.0.monterey.bottle.tar.gz
==> Downloading https://ghcr.io/v2/homebrew/core/cmake/blobs/sha256:090acb6a5c51b9a3b74508e7a93e3
==> Downloading from https://pkg-containers.githubusercontent.com/ghcr1/blobs/sha256:090acb6a5c51
######################################################################## 100.0%
==> Downloading https://ghcr.io/v2/homebrew/core/ninja/blobs/sha256:7a28d090cbec60072c3df5c35be0f
==> Downloading from https://pkg-containers.githubusercontent.com/ghcr1/blobs/sha256:7a28d090cbec
######################################################################## 100.0%
==> Pouring leaf-proxy--0.4.2.monterey.bottle.tar.gz
🍺  /usr/local/Cellar/leaf-proxy/0.4.2: 7 files, 6.2MB
==> Running `brew cleanup leaf-proxy`...
Disable this behaviour by setting HOMEBREW_NO_INSTALL_CLEANUP.
Hide these hints with HOMEBREW_NO_ENV_HINTS (see `man brew`).
```

### What did you expect to happen?

Build dependencies should not be downloaded during installation, when bottles are available.

### Step-by-step reproduction instructions (by running `brew` commands)

```shell
1. `export HOMEBREW_INSTALL_FROM_API=1`
2. `brew install leaf-proxy`
3. Notice how it downloads build dependencies (e.g. `rust`).
```

review_comments: Seems odd to me that it only happens in the fetch stage and only for API installs. Something must be done differently somewhere for this inconsistency to exist.

I think the correct fix should be creating the `Formula` object from json directly instead of from the downloaded bottle file IIUC, but that needs more work as the formula json API doesn't have any Linux dependencies.
Yeah, exactly. Should I remove the first commit or close this pull request?
You could cherry-pick #12936 into this PR and address the feedback from there here?

I'm fine with at least the second commit as a short-term fix - it's consistent to what we have elsewhere.

I wouldn't object to the first commit - but I feel like there's something wrong elsewhere if it doesn't happen at install time and only at fetch time.

`dependent.deps` at here contains all the dependencies including build dependencies, this happens also when core tap is cloned
https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/blob/b533b380e5e48a2092a93fa843f4bfb4eda8ee20/Library/Homebrew/dependency.rb#L101

then at this line `to_formula` will cause an error
https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/blob/b533b380e5e48a2092a93fa843f4bfb4eda8ee20/Library/Homebrew/dependency.rb#L128

then start downloading bottle and retry
https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/blob/b533b380e5e48a2092a93fa843f4bfb4eda8ee20/Library/Homebrew/formula_installer.rb#L221-L228

I'd like to apply the commit from the draft pr and work on that. It's just these json files lack Linux dependencies, should work fine on mac.

But why not download the [zip file of homebrew-core](https://github.com/Homebrew/homebrew-core/archive/refs/heads/master.zip) and use that as if the repo is cloned? It's about the same size of [formula.json](https://formulae.brew.sh/api/formula.json)(14M).

Ok that makes sense. I'm fine with the PR then as a fix until we can get rid of the API fetch layer everywhere.

In regards to Linux dependencies, there's an issue open for that: https://github.com/Homebrew/formulae.brew.sh/issues/566. It is likely a prerequisite before #12936 can ship.
